name: Convex-Treelike Classes Are Closed under Boolean Substitution
statement: Under nonempty distinct outer sections and a nonempty proper test, the substituted class belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ exactly when the outer class and test do. The natural empty, full, and equal-section boundary cases are included through products and sections.
proof: The two inputs are recovered as sections, giving necessity. For nested outer sections, induct through a recursive coordinate of the test; substitution is monotone in the test and produces nested recursively peripheral sections. For a general recursively peripheral outer class, induct through its recursive split. Substitution in the two smaller outer sections preserves their inclusion, so their outputs reconstruct a valid two-child peripheral recursion.
